meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 安装后，系统新增 Codex 作为代理供应商，可让对话组改用 OpenAI 的 Codex 而非 Claude，由它负责规划、工具调用、MCP 工具，并支持服务端历史与会话恢复。
howto.when: 当你在某个对话组执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 并重启该组时，Codex 接管该组；也可设置环境变量让之后新建的组默认使用 Codex。

say.text: 请按照 add-codex 技能安装 Codex provider。
say.note: 会拷贝代码、接入 CLI 并引导认证。

say.text: 把当前对话组的代理切换到 Codex。
say.note: 会运行配置命令并重启该组。

say.text: 让以后新建的对话组默认使用 Codex。
say.note: 会设置环境变量并重启服务。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill adds Codex as an agent provider, allowing a conversation group to use OpenAI's Codex instead of Claude for planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run `ncl groups config update --provider codex` on a conversation group and restart it, or when you set DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER so new groups use Codex by default.

say_en.text: Please use the add-codex skill to install the Codex provider.
say_en.note: Copies code, wires CLI, and guides authentication.

say_en.text: Switch the current conversation group to Codex.
say_en.note: Runs the config update and restarts the group.

say_en.text: Make new conversation groups default to Codex.
say_en.note: Sets the environment variable and restarts the service.
